verdicts.reasoning: The questions are formatted as mathematical word problems to be solved or verified, such as calculating the total money Tessie has or determining if Rosa accurately solved her word problem.
Each word problem requires adding given values, signaled by contextual cues like "total", "in all", "received ... more", or "put all ... together".
The problems center around combining numerical quantities, such as adding 8910 and 118 in seed 11.
The accurate sums computed across all seeds are under 10,000, for example, seed 11 evaluates to 9028 and seed 42 totals 6532.
Several seeds (11, 57, 64, 91, 127) explicitly use the peso sign (₱) and refer to 'money' or 'spending', presenting themselves as financial word problems.
